system.description: Win a Static Social Challenge and spend a Blood Trait to leave behind a spoken or sung sentence (extra sentences cost a Social Trait each) that lingers in a location, audible to whoever next stands there or to a specific familiar person; it can also delay another Melpominee power for later triggering by spending a Willpower Trait first. The echo persists up to a number of nights equal to your permanent Social Traits, either repeating indefinitely or fading after being heard once. Someone using Heightened Senses may notice a dormant echo, and with Occult and a won Static Mental Challenge can hear it, but failure deafens them for the rest of the night.
system.bloodCost: One Blood Trait (plus one Willpower Trait to delay another Melpominee power)
system.duration: Up to your permanent Social Traits, in nights
